# External index: anthropics/claude-cookbooks

Links only (license: MIT, Anthropic; commit `39cd5a7a3a29`). Recipes for building with Claude: agents, tools, RAG, evals, cost.
Read a recipe's notebook on GitHub when a task needs it. Overview: `research/ai-automation-and-building-2026-10.md`.
